title: Astra on the Skunk Works org chart

tellings.quote: Instead, what I saw above it was something called Astra.

plain: A writer named Nick Cook, who has investigated claims of anti-gravity aircraft, says that in the mid-1990s he was shown an organisation chart for the Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design division of the company Lockheed in Palmdale, California. He says that above the familiar units on the chart he saw a name, Astra, and that he noted it in his diaries. If true, it would point to a hidden programme sitting over even the most secret aircraft work.
